scripts.api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.seed:demo: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py
scripts.seed:reset: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py --reset
scripts.import:repos: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/import_repos.py
scripts.diagrams:gif: node scripts/render-gifs.mjs && uvx --with pillow python scripts/frames_to_gif.py
scripts.design:pdf: uvx --with markdown python scripts/design_html.py /tmp/eap-design.html && node scripts/render-design-pdf.mjs /tmp/eap-design.html
